description: One envelope generator giving four differently shaped envelopes at once out of four stage times and a sustain level, with a gate output for every stage

params.text: Sets the length of the first stage, from about 2ms to 32 seconds; turning it up shortens the stage
Sets the length of the second stage, from about 2ms to 32 seconds; turning it up shortens the stage
Sets the length of the third stage, from about 2ms to 32 seconds; turning it up shortens the stage
Sets the voltage the envelopes hold at through their sustain phase, 0V to 10V
Sets the length of the fourth stage, from about 2ms to 32 seconds; turning it up shortens the stage
Scales the T1 control input, -1 to +1, before it is added to the first stage's time
Scales the T2 control input, -1 to +1, before it is added to the second stage's time
Scales the T3 control input, -1 to +1, before it is added to the third stage's time
Scales the SUSTAIN control input, -1 to +1, before it is added to the sustain level
Scales the T4 control input, -1 to +1, before it is added to the fourth stage's time
Bends the slopes between logarithmic turned down, straight in the centre and exponential turned up, which also shifts the timing
Starts the envelopes while it is held down and holds them in sustain for as long as it is held

inputs.text: Shortens the first stage as the voltage rises, a volt an octave, scaled by its attenuverter
Shortens the second stage as the voltage rises, a volt an octave, scaled by its attenuverter
Shortens the third stage as the voltage rises, a volt an octave, scaled by its attenuverter
Moves the sustain level, scaled by its attenuverter
Shortens the fourth stage as the voltage rises, a volt an octave, scaled by its attenuverter
Starts the envelopes on a rise past 1.8V and holds them in sustain for as long as it stays high
Starts the envelopes on each rise past 1.8V; with no gate held high alongside it, they run straight through to the end
Shortens all four stage times together as the voltage rises, with no attenuation of its own

outputs.text: 5V while the ADASR envelope is in its first stage, and 0V otherwise
5V while the ADASR envelope is in its second stage, and 0V otherwise
5V while the ADASR envelope is in its third stage, and 0V otherwise
5V while the ADASR envelope is in its sustain phase, and 0V otherwise
5V while the ADASR envelope is in its fourth stage, and 0V otherwise
A delay, attack, decay, sustain and release envelope, 0V to 10V
An attack, hold, decay, sustain and release envelope, 0V to 10V
A delay, attack, hold and release envelope, 0V to 10V; this is the one shape that never sustains
An attack, decay, attack, sustain and release envelope, 0V to 10V, and the one whose timing the stage gates follow
5V when the ADASR envelope ends; patch it back into TRIGGER and the module cycles

notes: the module cannot be started again until the third stage has finished, so a trigger arriving before then is ignored, which is what makes it usable as a frequency divider
patch END back into TRIGGER and the module cycles as an oscillator, the stage times setting its frequency a volt an octave
the DAHR shape is the exception to the sustain rule: it goes to its release when the third stage ends, whatever the gate is doing
every input in this module reads one channel, so polyphonic cables are cut down to their first channel

inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.5:
high above 1.8V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.6:
high above 1.8V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
